name: DUFU
recent: Dufu 在 2026 年 10 月 27 日公布季度业绩，净利创四年新高。同期，公司因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，并有董事及高管申报持股变动。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利创四年新高。
因 ESOS 行使，于 2026 年 9 月 30 日及 10 月 30 日分批发行新股上市。
risks: 首席财务官 David Khoo Chong Beng 于 2026 年 9 月 22 日及 10 月 28 日申报减持股份。
主要子公司董事 Wong Ser Yian 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日及 10 月 28 日申报减持股份。
ESOS 行使导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 2026 年第三季营收为 MYR 89.619 million，环比下降 3.0%，但同比增长 31.3%；净利为 MYR 15.549 million，环比增长 11.9%，同比增长 456.3%；净利率为 17.4%，高于上一季度的 15.0%。

recent_en: Dufu announced its quarterly results on 27 Oct 2026, with net profit hitting a four-year high. In the same period, the company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises, and directors and senior management reported changes in their shareholdings.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, with net profit reaching a four-year high.
Listed new shares on 30 Sep 2026 and 30 Oct 2026 in batches due to ESOS exercises.
risks_en: Chief Financial Officer David Khoo Chong Beng reported disposals of shares on 22 Sep 2026 and 28 Oct 2026.
Wong Ser Yian, Director of a major subsidiary, reported disposals of shares on 5 Oct 2026 and 28 Oct 2026.
ESOS exercises have led to a gradual expansion of share capital.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was MYR 89.619 million, down 3.0% QoQ but up 31.3% YoY; net income was MYR 15.549 million, up 11.9% QoQ and 456.3% YoY; net margin was 17.4%, higher than 15.0% in the previous quarter.
